import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow, cost;

        Edge(int u, int v, long cap, long flow, long cost) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }

        long rem() {
            return cap - flow;
        }
    }

    static int nodes;
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] g;
    static ArrayList<Edge> e;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        g[u].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cost));
        g[v].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cost));
    }

    static long[] dist;
    static long mncost;
    static int[] pre;
    static long[] cap;
    static long mxflow;
    static boolean[] inq;

    static void flow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(inq, false);
        mxflow = 0;
        mncost = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, 0, nodes, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
            pre[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(cap, 0);
            cap[s] = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            inq[s] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inq[u] = false;
                for (int it = 0; it < g[u].size(); it++) {
                    int i = g[u].get(it);
                    Edge f = e.get(i);
                    if (f.rem() > 0 && dist[f.v] > dist[u] + f.cost) {
                        dist[f.v] = dist[u] + f.cost;
                        pre[f.v] = i;
                        cap[f.v] = Math.min(cap[u], f.rem());
                        if (!inq[f.v]) {
                            q.add(f.v);
                            inq[f.v] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (pre[t] == -1) break;
            long addflow = cap[t];
            long addcost = 0;
            for (int v = t; v != s; v = e.get(pre[v]).u) {
                int i = pre[v];
                addcost += addflow * e.get(i).cost;
                e.get(i).flow += addflow;
                e.get(i ^ 1).flow -= addflow;
            }
            mxflow += addflow;
            mncost += addcost;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        long c = sc.nextLong();
        long d = sc.nextLong();
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt(); // read but not used
        }
        nodes = 6 + 107 * n;
        g = new ArrayList[nodes];
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        e = new ArrayList<>();
        dist = new long[nodes];
        pre = new int[nodes];
        cap = new long[nodes];
        inq = new boolean[nodes];

        // read edges and build expanded graph
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int y = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < 105; t++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++) {
                    addEdge(t * n + x + 1, (t + 1) * n + y + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                    addEdge(t * n + y + 1, (t + 1) * n + x + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * j + 1));
                }
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < 105; t++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                addEdge(t * n + j + 1, (t + 1) * n + j + 1, 51, c);
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t < 105; t++) {
            addEdge(t * n + 1, 105 * n + 1, 51, 0);
        }
        flow(0, 105 * n + 1);
        System.out.println(mncost);
        sc.close();
    }
}
